chunks: Do not confuse truth with falsehood, nor conceal the truth knowingly.

key_terms.الْحَقَّ: The truth (divine reality or clear guidance)
key_terms.تَلْبِسُوا: To confuse or mix (truth with falsehood)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'conceal the truth' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, who are viewed as the custodians of divine truth, warning against the distortion of their teachings by opponents. It underscores the duty of scholars and believers to preserve the integrity of revelation, ensuring that the pure message of Islam is not obscured by sectarian bias or deliberate concealment of knowledge.
